profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Digital Operatives

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Communications protocol analysis and reconstruction using custom statistical analysis, data mining, and machine learning technologies. Using MSSQL, SSAS, SSIS to design, build, and maintain a highly scalable, multi-user platform for real-time analytics on large multi-dimensional data sets. Building and maintaining desktop dashboard application for multi-dimensional data visualization using C#, WPF, and MVVM.
